summary: Explain cross-network setup and retire stopped old autostart when reusing node data
details: The installer distinguishes selecting a tool from activating service images. upgrade-plan can discover an unambiguous prior network before target setup and show read-only data reuse; activate-release explains why a new network requires setup.

Setup, up and controller install inspect same-operator standard configurations that share data. After checking old containers are stopped, supported old controller and monitor units are disabled and verified before proceeding; configuration and datasets remain intact.

Running old controllers/containers, custom units, overrides and unobservable states block automatic retirement. Boot-time controller execution only checks and never requests sudo. A launcher/config network mismatch is rejected before starting services.
operator_actions: For a different network, stop the old node with its original kit, install the target tool, inspect upgrade-plan and run setup using the original data root for compatible reuse. Complete the switch before reboot; the installer alone does not change autostart.
With this tool version, supported old autostart sharing data is retired during setup/up; a separate controller disable is unnecessary. Resolve custom unit or stopped-state blockers when reported.
